description: This Java class 'RatingStatistics' extends 'Statistics' and provides methods to analyze ratings of books in a reading application. It includes functionalities such as finding the most liked (highest rated) book, least liked (lowest rated) book, and calculating the average rating across read books with ratings.

classes.name: RatingStatistics
classes.description: A class that provides statistical analysis of book ratings, such as identifying most and least liked books and calculating average ratings.

methods.name: findMostLikedBook
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Book with the highest rating from the readBooksRated list, or empty if not applicable.

methods.name: findLeastLikedBook
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Book with the lowest rating from the readBooksRated list, or empty if not applicable.

methods.name: calculateAverageRatingGiven
methods.description: Computes the average rating of all rated books in the readBooksRated list, or returns empty if there are insufficient ratings.

methods.name: findReadBooksWithRatings
methods.description: Populates the readBooksRated list with books from the shelf that have non-null ratings.

methods.name: calculateTotalRating
methods.description: Calculates the sum of ratings of all rated books in the list, converting ratings to double using RatingScale.
